cards.ex: The heavy rain triggered a massive rock slide, blocking the highway.
cards.exUz: Kuchli yomg'ir katta tosh surilishiga sabab bo'ldi va avtomagistralni to'sib qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Tog'dan katta toshlar birdan pastga qarab harakatlanishi.

cards.ex: We had a flash flood yesterday; the water rose incredibly fast.
cards.exUz: Kecha to'satdan suv toshqini bo'ldi; suv juda tez ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va kutilmaganda paydo bo'ladigan kuchli suv toshqini.

cards.ex: The storm will die down by morning, they say.
cards.exUz: Ular aytishicha, bo'ron ertalabga borib tinchlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kuch yoki intensivlik jihatidan kamaymoq, zaiflashmoq.

cards.ex: The volcanic eruption caused widespread ashfall in nearby towns.
cards.exUz: Vulkan otilishi yaqin shaharlarda keng tarqalgan kul tushishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Vulkan yoki geizerdan lava, kul va gazlarning chiqishi.

cards.ex: In the aftermath of the hurricane, many people were left homeless.
cards.exUz: Do'l oqibatida ko'p odamlar uysiz qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hodisa, ayniqsa falokatdan keyingi davr.

cards.ex: We live on the coast, so we're used to strong winds.
cards.exUz: Biz sohil bo'yida yashaymiz, shuning uchun kuchli shamollarga o'rganib qolganmiz.
cards.uzDef: Dengiz yoki okean qirg'og'ida joylashgan.

cards.ex: The temperature should level off around 25 degrees tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Harorat ertaga taxminan 25 daraja atrofida tekislanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishni to'xtatmoq va tekis bo'lib qolmoq.

cards.ex: The factory is located upstream from the town.
cards.exUz: Zavod shahardan daryo yuqorisida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Daryoning oqimga qarshi tomonda joylashgan.

cards.ex: We found debris from the flood downstream.
cards.exUz: Biz toshqin qoldiqlarini daryo quyisidan topdik.
cards.uzDef: Daryoning oqim bo'ylab pastki tomonda joylashgan.

cards.ex: The heat wave is expected to last for another week.
cards.exUz: Issiq to'lqin yana bir hafta davom etishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ancha issiq bo'lgan uzoq davr.

cards.ex: We had a cold snap last week and everything froze.
cards.exUz: O'tgan hafta sovuq urishi bo'ldi va hamma narsa muzlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda sovuq ob-havoning boshlanishi.

cards.ex: The earthquake really shook up the whole town.
cards.exUz: Zilzila butun shaharni jiddiy silkitib tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoq, o'zgartirmoq (maj.).

cards.ex: The mudslide destroyed several houses in the valley.
cards.exUz: Loy ko'chkisi vodiydagi bir nechta uylarni vayron qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yomg'ir tufayli hosil bo'lgan loy va tuproqning harakati.

cards.ex: The storm caused a widespread power outage.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron keng tarqalgan elektr uzilishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Elektr ta'minotining to'xtatilishi.

cards.ex: The raging fire consumed acres of forest in hours.
cards.exUz: Kuchli yong'in soatlab gektarlab o'rmonni yo'q qildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez tarqaladigan va nazorat qilish qiyin bo'lgan yong'in.

cards.ex: In the wake of the earthquake, aid organizations arrived.
cards.exUz: Zilziladan so'ng yordam tashkilotlari yetib kelishdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lgandan keyin.

cards.ex: Climate change is affecting global weather patterns.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi global ob-havo namunalariga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odatda takrorlanadigan ob-havo sharoitlari.

cards.ex: The drought has severely impacted local agriculture.
cards.exUz: Qurg'oqchilik mahalliy qishloq xo'jaligiga jiddiy ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida yog'ingarchilikning yetishmasligi.

cards.ex: A massive sinkhole opened up in the middle of the street.
cards.exUz: Ko'chaning o'rtasida katta o'pirilish paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yerning birdan o'pirilib ketishi, chuqur hosil bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The tidal wave destroyed everything in its path.
cards.exUz: To'lqin o'z yo'lidagi hamma narsani vayron qildi.
cards.uzDef: Dengizdagi zilzila tufayli kelib chiqadigan katta suv to'lqini.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, probably the change in climate.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz kasal his qilyapman, ehtimol iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, kasal bo'lib qolgan.

cards.ex: A brush fire broke out near the highway.
cards.exUz: Avtomagistral yaqinida butazor yong'ini chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Quruq o't va butalarda tez tarqaladigan kichik yong'in.

cards.ex: Their cabin is located in the middle of nowhere.
cards.exUz: Ularning kulbasi hech qayerda joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq, aholisiz joyda.

cards.ex: The town is built on a flood plain, so it's vulnerable.
cards.exUz: Shahar suv bosadigan tekislikda qurilgan, shuning uchun u zaif.
cards.uzDef: Daryo yaqinidagi suv toshishi xavfi bo'lgan tekis yer.

cards.ex: The avalanche buried the ski resort.
cards.exUz: Ko'chki chang'i kurortini ko'mib tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Tog'dan qor, muz va toshlarning tezda pastga siljishi.

cards.ex: We had to take shelter from the storm in a nearby cave.
cards.exUz: Biz bo'rondan yaqin atrofdagi g'orda panoh topishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsiz joyga borish, yashirinish.

cards.ex: Coastal erosion is a serious problem here.
cards.exUz: Sohil eroziyasi bu yerda jiddiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Suv, shamol yoki muz ta'sirida tuproqning yemirilishi.

cards.ex: The landslide blocked the road for several days.
cards.exUz: Tuproq ko'chkisi yo'lni bir necha kunga to'sib qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Tuproq va tosh massasining tog' yonbag'ridan pastga siljishi.

cards.ex: Amsterdam is located at sea level.
cards.exUz: Amsterdam dengiz sathida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Dengiz yuzasining balandligida.

cards.ex: The storm had a ripple effect on the entire economy.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron butun iqtisodiyotga zanjir reaktsiyasini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta voqea orqali boshqa voqealarning kelib chiqishi.
